description: This file is a shell script used for testing the reftable backend consistency check in a Git repository. It defines test procedures to verify the integrity of reftable tables within a Git repository, including renaming table files to test validation mechanisms.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a sequence of commands, and checks for no errors.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
